orders.title: Orders

payments.bookingHint: Confirmed payments are recorded but not posted — that is done manually, just like bank transfers.

withdrawals.subtitle: Received withdrawal declarations
withdrawals.name: Name
withdrawals.unmatched: No invoice found for this order number

partCard.title: Shop
partCard.listedHint: Only articles offered in at least one sales channel appear in the shop.
partCard.hyperlinkHint: Path of the product page on the shop website, without the base address. Leave empty to use the suggestion.
partCard.breadcrumbsHint: Steps of the shop navigation in order; confirm each with Enter.
partCard.imagesHint: File names on the shop website; confirm each with Enter. The first image is the thumbnail.
partCard.label: Label
partCard.saveError: The shop details could not be saved.
partCard.noPermission: You are not allowed to change shop details.
partCard.markupAmountNet: Net amount, like the sales price
partCard.markupAmountGross: Gross amount, like the sales price
partCard.pricePreview: Preview using the sales price and posting group of this form.
partCard.channelTitleHint: Leave empty to use the article description.
partCard.unavailableHint: Stays listed in the channel but cannot be ordered. HugoShop: “Currently unavailable” without cart button; marketplaces: quantity 0.
partCard.obsoleteHint: The article is marked as “obsolete” and is therefore unavailable in all channels.
partCard.channelDescriptionHint: Leave empty to use the article's long description.
partCard.serviceNotOnMarketplace: Services are not offered on marketplaces.
partCard.imagesAfterCreate: Images can be added once the article has been created.
partCard.imageError: The image could not be processed.
partCard.channelDefaultHint: Leave empty to use the default from the settings.

publish.title: Publishing
publish.hint: The shop pages are created on the next run of the publishing script.
publish.allNowHint: Creates the job “All products” and runs it right away.
publish.installUiHint: Transfers the package with the shop widgets to the website and rebuilds it — like the scheduled runner, but right away.
publish.running: A run is already in progress — it will handle the jobs.
publish.cleanupHint: Deletes the successfully completed jobs. Failed and pending ones remain.
publish.cleanupConfirm: All successfully completed jobs will be deleted, {count} of them in this list.
publish.deleteHint: Jobs that have not run yet are deleted as well; they are then no longer queued.
publish.runBlocked: The selection contains a failed job. Only pending jobs can be run.
publish.inProgress: Publishing is running in the background — the page stays usable.
publish.aborted: The run was interrupted before it finished.
publish.tooLong: The run is taking longer than expected. The display is no longer updated – please reload the page later.

channelConfig.title: Sales channels
channelConfig.intro: Defaults per channel for all articles without their own markup. The base price is the article's sales price.
channelConfig.activeLast: At least one sales channel must be enabled.
channelConfig.round99Hint: 12.30 becomes 12.99 and 13.00 becomes 13.99. A price ending in .99 stays.
channelConfig.round99NetWarning: Sales prices are stored net. The net price is derived from the rounded gross price; invoices may differ from the cart by one cent. Recommended: keep sales prices gross (setting above).
channelConfig.invalidPercent: A discount of 100 % or more is not possible.
channelConfig.republishQueued: Saved. The product pages will be rewritten with the new prices.
channelConfig.saveError: The channel settings could not be saved.
channelConfig.loadError: The sales channels could not be loaded.
